title: Tagset entry
description: One value in data/languages/<iso3>/tagset.yaml, an object keyed by tag mnemonic (tools/validate/schema/store-layout.schema.json's tagsetFile def). Field names from issue 16: 'one entry per tag with its category, its parent attribute if any, and its meaning'. category and parent are always null: the archive's live export (exports/export_tagset.php) is a flat alphabetical list with no field linking a value tag to the attribute it belongs under, unlike the wiki's hand-drawn Tagset.wikitext tree (docs/factory/store-schema.md, 'Tagset entry'; docs/unl-reference/formats/tagset.md, 'Where the export adds tags the wiki tree does not define').

tag.description: The tag mnemonic itself (e.g. RLT, FOR, LEX), identical to this record's own key in tagset.yaml.

meaning.description: The short expansion the export gives the tag before its first parenthesis (e.g. 'relation' for RLT, 'formal' for FOR).

description.description: The export's longer description, from inside the tag's parenthesis (or parentheses -- some entries, e.g. 123PP, carry more than one top-level group, joined with a space). Empty string when the export gives no description at all (e.g. DFN, 'defineteness', an archive typo kept verbatim).

examples.description: The export's own ... example list for the tag, split on top-level commas, or empty when the export gives none.

category.description: The attribute this tag's value sits under (e.g. LEX for A), per SPEC.md's tree model. Always null: the archive's live export never states this link (see this schema's own description). Kept as a field, not dropped, so a future pass that recovers the link (e.g. from the wiki tree, cross-checked against the live tagset) needs no migration.

parent.description: Same gap as category, for a tag that is itself a value of another value (a rarer case the wiki tree draws in places). Always null today, same reason.

archive_path.description: Path under data/archive/ the record was read from: exports/export_tagset.php for every tag, since the export is one file shared by every language store (SPEC.md §3.3).

line.description: The tag's own mnemonic, used as an importer-assigned locator: the export gives no per-tag physical line (docs/factory/store-schema.md, 'Tagset entry'), the same allowance dictionary-entry.schema.json and grammar-rule.schema.json already document for a paradigm or frame catalogue number.
